content.text: Confirmed: no transition assistance, data return, or deletion obligations exist anywhere. I'll insert a new subsection in the termination section.

input.summary: Insert § 6(c) requiring post-termination transition assistance, return of Company data/Works and certified deletion.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a post-termination exit provision because the Agreement currently ends without any obligation to help us transition or to give back our data, Works and Confidential Information. Our position is up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, return in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days, return to Company all Works, Company data and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such Works, Company data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
